latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Recovery & Rest Architect skill.

- Helps users design structured recovery routines covering sleep, nutrition timing, active recovery, and deload weeks.
- Guides users through assessment of training load, fatigue/soreness patterns, and recovery gaps.
- Provides day-by-day weekly recovery schedules alongside training.
- Suggests at least five active recovery activities tailored to individual needs.
- Explains deload week structure, with volume reduction templates and scheduling advice.
- Lists subjective and objective warning signs of under-recovery, with recommended actions and safety boundaries.
